title: Keep public API contracts explicit and narrow
statement: Model public inputs and outputs with named typed contracts, validate at the boundary, preserve stable JSON names, and avoid exposing persistence or framework internals as API shape.
rationale: Quality Studio's API records and core review contracts are integration boundaries shared with the browser and Agent Studio. Explicit contracts make compatibility and validation reviewable.

examples.good:
public sealed record StartReviewRequest(string Path, string Kind, bool Force = false);
public Task<ReviewRunResponse> EnqueueAsync(StartReviewRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken);

history.change: Initial .NET API-shape seed grounded in Quality Studio API contracts.
